manifest.name: MidiProvider
manifest.description: Play built-in MIDI samples or your own files with stereo and instrument-family audio.

midi_file.label: Custom MIDI file
midi_file.description: Optional absolute path to a Type 0 or Type 1 MIDI file on the server. Built-in samples are always available in Browse.

soundfont.label: Custom General MIDI SoundFont
soundfont.description: Optional absolute path to a GM-compatible .sf2 file on the server. Leave empty to use the included TimGM6mb instruments.
